verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data downloads are a fair question for a government IP registry, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows interactive search tools (by number, owner, keyword or image), an online trade marks journal, and per-document copy requests. None of these is a documented bulk dataset or registry extract that removes the need for scraping, and the probe found the search host restricts automated agents via robots.txt.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
